login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use the account issued by your administrator.
login.firstLoginHint: The first sign-in requires a password change and two-factor authentication.
login.expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app (Google/Microsoft Authenticator).
mfa.emailSent: A verification code has been sent to your email.
mfa.setupIntro: Your role requires two-factor authentication. Scan the QR code with an authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code to finish.
mfa.secret: Secret key (if you cannot scan the QR code)
mfa.recoveryIntro: Store these 10 recovery codes somewhere safe. Each code can be used once if you lose your authenticator device.
mfa.recoverySaved: I have saved my recovery codes

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.intro: Enter your username or email. If the account exists, a password reset link (valid for 15 minutes) will be sent.
forgot.noSmtp: Email is not configured. Please contact the administrator to reset your password.

reset.title: Reset password
reset.done: Your password has been reset. Please sign in with the new password.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.firstLogin: This is your first sign-in or your password has expired. Please change your password to continue.
changePassword.policy: At least 10 characters with upper-case, lower-case, digit and special characters; must differ from your last 5 passwords.

privacy.title: Personal data processing notice
privacy.intro: Please read the notice below before using the system.
